plainText:
Lee Quick is a voice actress for the English dub of . She is also credited as Heather Quick or Heather Lee.

==Biography==
Quick was born on August 30, 1968, in Jefferson County, Kentucky. During the 1990s and 2000s, she had a career as a voice actress. Though she got few roles overall, her best-known one was as Officer Jenny from the first season to the seventh season of . Jamie Davyous Owens took over the role in the following season, and Quick has not had any major roles since. She currently resides in New York City, New York.
